title: Use the short rejection witness without claiming general counting hardness
statement: The completed report gives coNP-complete global admission even when H_star has dimension2. A non-admission certificate lists at mostm independent directions, each witnessed as D(s) or Delta_h F0(s) with h in the preceding forced span, then an original-state gain/second-difference violation in that span. Its checker uses original circuit evaluation and linear algebra, with NO solver calls or intermediate UNSAT proofs. The comparator contributed this rejection-certificate argument. Rejection is complete for the stated ALL-state fixed-translation class; it need not imply difficulty from one reachable initial region or for another representation.
